𓂀𓋹𓆣𓊽𓇳𓂀𓋹𓆣𓊽𓇳𓂀𓋹𓆣𓊽𓇳𓂀𓋹𓆣𓊽𓇳

I’m Tamer, a Master’s student at TH Wildau majoring in Sustainability and Marketing, and I live in Berlin. My path began in digital marketing and led me through resort operations to a travel company I helped build from the ground up.

At Sky Elgandoul Resort in Hurghada I moved from accounting into operations, and I learned up close how a hospitality business runs day to day.

Then came Octopus Travel. I joined as a WordPress developer and co-founding business partner when it operated from a single branch in Cairo, and I helped scale it by launching our second branch in Hurghada from scratch. I co-directed operations with my partners and took full ownership of our digital infrastructure, building the website and the workflows behind it.

Then I moved to Germany. Today I study European Business Management and bring that hands-on experience into every course and project, while finding my place in the German academic and professional world.

Digital Infrastructure

Building websites and digital workflows that keep a business running.

Venture Operations

Hands-on scaling and financial control, from resort accounting to a growing travel company.

Sustainable Strategy

Integrating responsible growth frameworks into business decisions.

A few things I enjoy outside work, and how they shape the way I work.

𓊽

Cars, laptops and computers

I like fixing things. I restore and maintain my own car, working through its retrofits and mechanics, and I repair laptops and computers too. Tracking down the root of a problem and solving it properly is one of my favourite feelings.

𓂀

Fitness and growth

I train regularly at fitness clubs in Berlin, mixing cardio and weights. I track my progress, set new targets and keep improving, and I bring the same habit of measuring and refining to my work.

𓋹

Egypt and Germany

I come from Alexandria and I’m proud of my Egyptian roots. My travel agency had offices in Hurghada and Cairo, where I built my industry experience. Now I study and work in Berlin, and I enjoy connecting both worlds.

𓇳

Markets and charts

I love trading and I read charts using several different methods. It sharpens the analytical thinking I use in marketing analytics and business decisions.

𓆣

I’m at my best when I’m solving a tricky operational problem, making a website easier to use, or turning a creative business idea into something real.
